category_title: Socially withdrawn learners characterized by fear of mockery, isolation, and lack of social initiative
scenario_title: Group work and joint class activities
minimal_context: The student is expected to join a group of peers to perform an assigned task during a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get into your groups and start working on the assigned tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits at his desk alone) I didn't want to participate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to participate in the joint class activities.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They are all joking, doing something, laughing; I feel ill at ease.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go over to your group and start a conversation with them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Nobody associates, nobody talks to you... to start first, no, I can't do that. (Refuses to perform the tasks assigned to the group)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please get into your groups and start working on the assigned tasks.

STUDENT: (Sits at his desk alone) I didn't want to participate.

STUDENT: Nobody associates, nobody talks to you... to start first, no, I can't do that. (Refuses to perform the tasks assigned to the group)

task.content: perform the tasks assigned to the group, participate in joint class activities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to initiate social contact or collaborative activities with peers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: sat at his desk alone, nobody talked to him during breaks, refuse to perform the tasks assigned to the group
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: too shy to talk to somebody himself, felt unpleasant, unsafe and ill at ease

behavior_patterns.internal_state: too shy to start conversation first
